CheckTitle: Ensure Changes to Payment Setups Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: High Risk Business Transactions & User Actions
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod with Basic Auth (Connection page): HCM REST personalPaymentMethods and userAccounts; optionally Financials REST externalBankAccounts
Description: Changes to payment methods and bank account setups should be audited and reviewed.
Risk: A changed payment setup can redirect payments, which are hard to recover.
AuditProcedure: Enable audit policies for payment setup attributes and review Audit Reports.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 60002, 60005, 60007.

Steps: Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

Notes: Automated by outcome delta: each run snapshots employee payment methods (and supplier bank accounts when readable) and compares with the previous run. Only the last 4 characters and a keyed hash of account numbers are stored. Run the assessment daily. Whether audit policies / Risk Management controls are enabled stays with the assessor.
